open_points.subject: AuditEntry creation for accepted no-op actions
open_points.text: “One significant change of state” and “The actions that write an entry ... archiving, anonymising ... erasing a customer” conflict when archiving an archived project, anonymising an anonymised project, or erasing an erased customer returns the record unchanged.
open_points.question: Does an accepted action that returns an already archived, anonymised or erased record unchanged create an AuditEntry?
options: Create an entry because the named action was accepted.
Create no entry because no state changed.
Define the rule separately for each idempotent action.
open_points.default_guess: Create no entry because R0-58 limits the log to significant changes of state.
